story: Nia wanted to water the sunflower, but the tomato seedlings were thirsty. Mr Bell said, “The tap is broken.” The rain barrel held one can of water. Nia filled the watering can from the rain barrel. Nia said, “I can divide water equally.” Nia divided water equally between the tomato seedlings and the sunflower. The shade cloth fell. Nia secured the umbrella above the tomato seedlings with the garden tie. Nia moved the sunflower under the umbrella. Mr Bell said, “I promise to repair the tap tomorrow.” The tomato seedlings and the sunflower stood under the umbrella.

Mr Bell repairs the tap.
Nia waters the tomato seedlings with water from the tap.
Mrs Okafor uses the clip to repair the shade cloth.
The tomato seedlings stand under the repaired shade cloth, but the tomato seedlings have a brown leaf.

story: Nia wants to water the sunflower, but the tomato seedlings are thirsty. Mr Bell says, “The tap is broken.” The rain barrel holds one can of water. Nia fills the watering can from the rain barrel. Nia says, “I want to water the sunflower first.” Nia uses the watering can to water the sunflower. The shade cloth falls. The tomato seedlings have a brown leaf. Nia secures the umbrella above the tomato seedlings with the garden tie. Mr Bell repairs the tap. Nia waters the tomato seedlings with water from the tap. Mrs Okafor repairs the shade cloth with the clip. The tomato seedlings stand under the repaired shade cloth, but the tomato seedlings have a brown leaf.
